searchText: What are the current implementations of KZG commitments out there? I know of <@203220829473996800>'s in Go, are there others? Any elliptic curve fast linear combination implementation is a KZG commitment implementation, no? Yeah but I'm really looking for libraries to play with. I understand that most of the implementation details and optimization will be on the library dealing with the elliptic curve operations. But concretely fixing say a BLS implementation I want to see what libraries for KZG commitments are out there. I'm trying to think of ways that I may be useful (if ever) and want to weigh between implementation or specs and I want to give implementation a chance https://github.com/benjaminion/c-kzg Oh thanks! That's pretty much what I was hoping I didn't need to do... Having it in C is great
